notes: Data safety: all data files are written atomically (never half-written), no account can vanish from Account Info except by a real delete, grid edits only write the cells you changed, full data backups at startup / every 6h / before every update, and a startup check offers to restore accounts or 24/7 pages that suddenly went missing. 24/7: accounts are only auto-removed after a relogin really failed and are put back automatically once they work again; Copy Link is cross-checked against the post's own id.
